author: luna_seed_author
reviewNotes: Under the 2023 Company Law, a limited-liability-company shareholder may bring a derivative suit without a percentage threshold after the statutory demand/refusal or delay conditions; a joint-stock-company shareholder must satisfy the continuous 180-day and 1% holding threshold. A derivative action is brought in the shareholder’s own name, with the company benefiting; exceptions can remove the demand step. Given this LLC and the options, C (suing in the company’s name) is the prohibited form. The analysis’ explanation of A/B/D as qualified or erroneous assertions is consistent. Official current text: https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923395.htm .

author: luna_seed_author
reviewNotes: The case expressly fixes the board resolution in December 2017 and suit in January 2018, so using the 2013 Company Law Article 22 is appropriate. Official historical text: https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2014/content_2561297.htm .
